verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB's own marketing describes CHKit as giving agents 'typed commands' to describe, validate, test, and deploy schema and pipelines as code in CI. That is a first-party command tool an agent can drive, but the evidence never explicitly calls it a CLI and covers only schema/pipeline workflows. Compatibility with stock ClickHouse clients is a host-platform capability, and the MCP server belongs to a different story, so neither is credited here. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that CHKit is an official CLI with install and reference docs, CLI coverage beyond schema/pipelines (cluster management, querying, monitoring), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: CHKit gives them typed commands to describe, validate, test, and deploy schema and pipelines as code: infrastructure an agent can drive, in CI, with a diff you can review.
